key_highlights: ASX primed to open higher following overnight global equity gains and strong momentum in resources and energy.
Persistent and worse-than-expected inflation prints continue to exert upward pressure on RBA rate expectations.
Federal/state domestic gas reservation legislation rubber-stamped, introducing structural regulatory adjustments for energy producers.
Flight Centre confirms a major cyber security breach affecting a significant customer cohort, creating near-term operational risk.
Housing market strains escalate with rising negative equity, builder insolvencies, and Brisbane price corrections.

sectors.trend: Resources sector experiencing strong rebound supported by overseas market gains and gold exploration activity.
sectors.implications: Favourable setup for diversified miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) and gold producers capitalizing on safe-haven bullion demand.

sectors.trend: Crude oil rebound provides immediate support, but early morning passage of gas reservation policy caps domestic pricing power.
sectors.implications: Divergence between global liquid exporters and domestic gas producers; margin scrutiny for WDS.AX and STO.AX.

sectors.trend: Sticky inflation keeps cash rates elevated, increasing consumer mortgage stress and negative equity risks.
sectors.implications: Net interest margins remain supported for major banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX), but bad debt provisioning concerns are mounting.

sectors.trend: Developer distress and substantial property corrections in cities like Brisbane weigh on asset valuations.
sectors.implications: Downside risk for residential developers and commercial trusts facing cap rate adjustments and refinancing costs.

sectors.trend: Tight household budgets and discretionary caution compounded by high-profile cyber incident at Flight Centre.
sectors.implications: Short-term selloff risk for FLT.AX and continued valuation pressure across discretionary retail (HVN.AX).

key_themes: Resource-led index support amidst broader global risk rally.
Sticky inflation entrenching higher-for-longer RBA monetary policy stance.
Government intervention in domestic energy markets via gas reservation rules.
Household debt vulnerability amid falling dwelling equity and high borrowing costs.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and leveraged REITs; tilt toward cash-flow-resilient resources.
Focus on upstream energy producers with primary exposure to unconstrained international LNG contracts.
Hedge exposure to retail banking and prioritize banks with conservative loan-to-value ratios and CET1 capital buffers.
Review operational risk exposure in consumer platforms and price in reputational discounts for affected firms.

opportunities.rationale: Global stock optimism and commodity/energy rebounds offset macro risks while gold assets hedge stubborn inflation.
Firming global oil benchmarks provide revenue upside despite domestic gas reservation headwinds.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Retail and Discretionary Travel Exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: High mortgage stress dampens retail demand, while corporate cybersecurity incidents present immediate headwind.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into Defensive Healthcare and Consumer Staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Inelastic earnings profiles insulate portfolios against stagflationary pressures and household belt-tightening.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX expected to open firm on global tailwinds and commodity strength, but upside will be capped by local rate fears.
market_outlook.long_term: Multi-month trajectory constrained by sticky inflation, RBA restrictive policy, and ongoing housing market adjustments.
key_catalysts: Official RBA monetary policy communications and inflation expectations updates.
Implementation guidelines and export quotas under the newly approved gas reservation regime.
Impact assessment, customer notifications, and regulatory fallout from Flight Centre cyber breach.
Global crude oil demand signals and post-Thanksgiving US equity market momentum.
watch_list: Monthly headline and trimmed-mean CPI data releases.
3-year and 10-year Australian Commonwealth Government Bond yields.
Mortgage stress, 90-day delinquency figures, and auction clearance rates.
Brent crude and Singapore iron ore futures benchmarks.
